item.title: REGOL 1.8: a lift can now ask for a different set each time
item.description: Every set of a lift can now ask for its own rep range and reps in reserve, and REGOL judges each one against what it asked for. Also: Why these weights on Today, full-size lift charts, rebuilt share cards, and Plans split into two tabs.
